g.aria-label: Why Prefix Hashing Beats Static AST Variable-Name Dataflow
Static AST Variable Dataflow Fails On…
1. PRNG stream shift: adding 1 random draw
D2L Prefix Rule (Cells k..n Marked Stale)
Any edit to Cell k invalidates Cells k..n
Recomputing Cell k requires running Cells 1..k−1
Because a fresh kernel must replay cells 1..k−1 to reach cell k, running through cell n
costs almost no extra time while guaranteeing complete end-to-end consistency.
